comments.author: @Epiclandwow
comments.text: What's going on with your channel? Why has YouTube suddenly stopped recommending your videos as much as before?

replies.author: @DanielVelasco-n9q2t
replies.text: YouTube’s algorithm isn't broken—it’s just finally reserving this peaceful sanctuary for those of us who actually need soul-healing, rather than pushing it to mindless scrollers.

replies.author: @travellives99
replies.text: @BestTravel2 I think your audience has watched so much of your content that they are now setting out to explore the very places you once told them about. Just wait for them to return from their trips.

replies.author: @BestTravel2
replies.text:
YouTube’s algorithm can be a bit mysterious sometimes! We’re always working hard to create the best content possible, and we really appreciate you noticing.

Some people say shadowbans don’t exist, while others believe they do. I always thought they didn’t exist either — until now. It could also be that too many other channels have copied our videos and content, which may have affected the channel as well. It’s hard to know exactly what’s going on.

But we’re not giving up just yet. We’re giving it one more week and will do everything we can to bring the channel back. If nothing changes after that, we may have to stop uploading.
